messages:
maria: quick heads-up — after merging Sylph LoRA (v2.1) into base-sparrow-7b-int4 we ran the quickpack. Seeing a big drop on factual QA and some hallucinations on invoice examples. attaching snippets and numbers.

ashok: can you paste the eval numbers?

maria: pasted run summary:
```
eval cmd: ./run_eval --model base-sparrow-7b-int4+Sylph-v2.1 --dataset invoices-qa --metrics exact_match,f1,fluency
results: exact_match 0.63 -> baseline 0.89
example failure: Q: \"What is total due?\" A: \"August 12\" <-- hallucination
```

jess: oof that's a large regression. Did Sylph change the tokenizer during finetune?

maria: Sylph claims tokenizer unchanged, but training used a custom BOS marker. Quick check shows vocab size identical but a special token <INV_START> was added.

lenore: have we reproduced this with float16 or int8? could be a quantization interaction.

maria: fp16+Sylph EM ~0.88 (close to baseline). int8 ~0.86. int4 drops to 0.63 only when the LoRA merge is applied. So looks like an int4+LoRA merge interaction.

ci-bot: artifact created: sylph-v2.1-lora-merge-2026-03-21

ashok: triage steps i'll run: 1) lora-only inference (no weight merge) 2) merged float32 run 3) dump KV cache differences 4) check prompt-prefix/token-offset handling (possible token index shift)

maria: did lora-only run: EM 0.87. merged float32: 0.86. merged+int4: 0.63. So merging+quant seems to trigger failure. Hypothesis: merge script quant rounding or layer ordering bug.

jess: can you dump single-token softmax logits for a failing example across variants? tiny differences will point to where heads go off.

maria: sample logits for failing prompt (trimmed):
```
input: \"Total due: ?\"
float32-merged logits top: {\"$\": 12.4, \"date\": 9.1, \"August\": 3.2}
int4-merged logits top: {\"August\": 11.8, \"$\": 7.0, \"12\": 2.1}
```

ashok: that pattern looks like a head-scale mismatch — attention distribution flipped to favor token \"August\" after quant rounding.

lenore: assign hardware/kernel repro: try same artifact with triton kernels vs cuBLAS fallback, see if numerical behavior differs.

jess: action items: maria -> run compare-kv-dump and upload artifacts; ashok -> grep merge script for recent scale/clamp changes; lenore -> repro with different kernels.

maria: started compare-kv-dump, uploaded artifacts: https://redwood.internal/runs/3112223334/artifacts (contains diffs and failing examples)

ashok: found suspicious change in merge tool: PR #7421 clamps per-head scales during quantization. rolling a patch that reverts clamp for LoRA-merged params.

maria: quick test of patched merge + int4: EM improved to 0.85 on the quickpack — not fully restored but much better. Kicking off full quickpack overnight. thanks all :thumbsup:

ci-bot: nightly-eval scheduled for 2026-03-22T03:00Z

jess: if nightly still fails let's log a short postmortem and block that merge until we have clear fix.

maria: will update thread tomorrow with final numbers.
